By Ryan Ballengee ,
2 days ago CHON BURI, THAILAND - FEBRUARY 22: Jeeno Thitikul of Thailand poses with the trophy after winning the tournament following the final round of the Honda LPGA Thailand 2026 at Siam Country Club on February 22, 2026 in Chon Buri, Thailand. (Photo by Thananuwat Srirasant/Getty Images) The 2026 The Chevron Championship continues the 2026 LPGA Tour schedule with the event at Memorial Park Golf Course in Houston, Texas, welcoming 132 world-class players to the LPGA major championship.
The 2026 The Chevron Championship betting odds indicate this week's LPGA Tour betting favorite is Nelly Korda, who comes in at 5-to-1 (+500) betting odds. Korda has a win and three second-place finishes this year.
Jeeno Thitikul is next best on the odds board at 12-to-1 to start the week, and she looks to break through in a major for the first time.
Hyo Joo Kim and Hannah Green are sitting on 16-to-1, each looking to win for a third time this season on the LPGA Tour.

2026 The Chevron Championship betting picks This week, the LPGA is at a new venue for their first major, staying in the Houston area to go to the home of the Texas Children's Houston Open on the PGA Tour. This is a public course, and it's meant to be somewhat wide open from tee to green. That might create opportunities for the longest LPGA players to benefit.
Nelly Korda is an obvious pick and also a bad value, but there's a very good chance she'll win here.
Auston Kim is a great value on 50/1, as she's a long hitter and has been trending toward a big win.
Patty Tavatanakit just got herself into a playoff in Los Angeles last week, and now she's 100/1 to win a major on a course where length is a huge edge?!
